run_llm_training: run an LLM training job using autotrain with a specified model and dataset
register_llm_subcommand: register the llm subcommand parser with argparse for autotrain cli
create_llm_command: create a RunAutoTrainLLMCommand instance from parsed cli arguments
validate_llm_training_args: validate required arguments like project name, data path, and model for LLM training
parse_block_size: parse a comma-separated block size string into an integer or list of integers
